description: This file defines platform-specific functions for upgrading firmware images in a Linux-based embedded system. It contains functions to check the image and perform the upgrade based on the board type, including specific handling for certain boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A simple function that always returns success (0), used to validate the firmware image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, choosing the correct method based on the board name.
